name: MANHUACU
source: INMET automatic station · official hourly archive

rules.time: UTC days, 00:00–24:00. Hourly extrema and rainfall assigned to the preceding hour. NASA uses local solar time; midnight boundaries differ.
rules.rain: 24 valid hourly reports required per day; all calendar days required per month. Missing is not zero.
rules.extremes: Daily Tmin/Tmax use hourly reported extrema, only with all 24 hours available. Gaps remain blank.
rules.rh: Daily mean of the 24 hourly UTC readings; all 24 required.
